title: Catallaxy: A Council of AI Personas Watching Your Coding Agent
summary: Max Marty shows Catallaxy, a council of AI personas that watch a Claude Code session and flag problems.

chapters.title: Q&A: Do Personas Talk to Each Other
Q&A: CLI Calls and Token Use
Closing: Agreement Means a Real Problem

learn: He got tired of copy-pasting between windows to have Codex or Gemini review Claude Code's work, so he built a tool that does it; he shows an early version from March.
Personas are different prompts and focuses, such as security, simplicity, finding existing libraries, UI and UX, and testing, each running on a model you choose.
Alerts can be copied back into Claude Code, and he adjudicates which matter; the same persona can run on several models for more diverse answers.
When several personas flag the same problem, it is probably real. Personas can be dispatched manually or automatically, and can be shared through an exchange.
A credential redaction system strips things that look like API keys or environment variables before anything is sent to a model.
